newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 12.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 12.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average rises 32.91 points to 7169.53 on Friday.
* On Friday, the Composite Index gained only 0.23 of a point to 1,107.37 on a lack of buying interest.
* Analysts expect selective buying on blue chips with situational second-liners leading trade.
* Red Box said on Friday it has terminated a deal under which it was to be taken over by a private company.
* Sungei Way Holdings said it plans to build a three billion ringgit "underground city" in Kuala Lumpur.
* Trenergy said it has signed an agreement to sell its U.S.-based subsidiary Hercules Offshore Corp, for $145 million.
* Businessman Azman Firdaus Shafii plans to be Metacorp's single largest shareholder with a proposal to buy Intria's 23.3 percent stake in the company.
